Name: Radiant Bell
Components: V, S, M (a silvered choir bell* worth at least 5 gp, which the spell consumes)
Description:
You ring an arcane, silver bell, imbuing it with healing magics that cure the afflicted. Choose any number of creatures within range. For each target, you can end one of the following conditions: charmed, frightened, poisoned, petrified, or stunned. This cure does not work if a target is deafened.

It is rumored that the soft ringing carries its energies across planes.
Sourcebook: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt
